source.title: Union path refuses an int constant for a uint alternative that the non-union target accepts

reverification.probe: take_union(5) into `uint | String` prints `union 5` on both corpus passes; the analyzer error from the report no longer fires.

rationale: The union family already resolves the numeric-constant source into a union destination on both surfaces through the union_numeric_constant anchor; the matrix is the regression guard.
